run_treeviz_kuhn_poker: run the treeviz example to generate a game tree visualization for kuhn_poker
run_treeviz_custom_game: run the treeviz example with a custom game name and output file path
run_treeviz_group_infosets: run the treeviz example with group_infosets enabled to group identical decision nodes
run_treeviz_group_terminal: run the treeviz example with group_terminal enabled to group terminal nodes
run_treeviz_group_pubsets: run the treeviz example with group_pubsets enabled to group public states
